exposure: Pulmonary vascular disease (PVD) at 7 days post-birth
Mechanical ventilator support at 7 days post-birth
outcome: Late respiratory disease (LRD) (defined as asthma, reactive airways disease, BPD exacerbation, bronchiolitis, pneumonia, or respiratory-related hospitalization)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 221 preterm infants born before 34 weeks postmenstrual age, with a median gestational age of 27 weeks and a median birth weight of 920g.
finding: Early pulmonary vascular disease (PVD) at 7 days after preterm birth, especially in combination with mechanical ventilator support, was identified as a strong risk factor for late respiratory disease (LRD) during early childhood.
gest_age: Median 27 weeks (IQR 25-28 weeks), all born before 34 weeks PMA
